cert_assessment.note: Vendor cites DIN 628 (angular contact ball bearings) and DIN ISO 281 (dynamic load ratings/rating life) — related rolling bearing standards but not ISO 15243 (bearing damage and failure classification), so near_equivalent, not exact.

vendor_standard.source: page 1, paragraph 'Our company holds ISO 9001:2015 certification'

expiry.assumption: German date format DD.MM.YYYY converted to ISO format

cert_assessment.note: Vendor states its own company holds ISO 9001:2015 certification with certificate number, issuer and validity — matches the supplier quality-system requirement exactly.

ambiguities: Quality reference is to DIN 628 / DIN ISO 281; no ISO 15243 conformity is stated — confirm whether ISO 15243 can be certified.

Prices are EXW Stuttgart with freight, insurance, customs and duties for buyer's account, whereas lead time '6 weeks after receipt of order, ex works' excludes transit to Pune — delivered date against need-by 2026-11-18 must be assessed separately.
Whether the 3% volume rebate on orders exceeding EUR 5.000 net applies to the combined order (Summe 3.476,00 as quoted is below the threshold).
The offer does not state VAT/GST treatment or whether unit prices are per single bearing assembly explicitly (inferred from 'Unit price' column against Qty).
